#Create metadata
```{r}
## If plates gets fliped while treating in excel use =INDEX($P$12:$AA$19, 9-ROW(A1), 13-COLUMN(A1))
plate_map_files <- list.files(
  cell_profiler_input_path,
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Get all tif files recursively
files <- list.files(
  image_path,
  pattern = "\\.tif$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Build metadata table
df <- tibble(filepath = files) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Plate = str_extract(filepath, "Plate\\s*\\d+"),
    Plate = str_remove(Plate, "Plate\\s*")
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(filename = basename(filepath)) %>%
  
  separate(
    filename,
    into = c("pos", "site", "rest"),
    sep = "-",
    extra = "merge",
    fill = "right"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    rest = str_remove(rest, "\\.tif$"),
    row = as.integer(substr(pos, 1, 3)),
    well_number = as.integer(substr(pos, 4, 6)),
    Site = as.integer(site),
    channel = as.integer(str_sub(rest, -1)),
    Plate = str_extract(filepath, "(?<=Plate\\s)\\d+")
  )

# Convert to 96-well format
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    row_letter = LETTERS[row],
    Well = paste0(row_letter, well_number)
  )

# Channel/stain mapping
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    stain = case_when(
      channel == 1 ~ "DNA",
      channel == 2 ~ "Mito",
      channel == 3 ~ "AGP",
      channel == 4 ~ "ER",
      channel == 5 ~ "RNA",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


#read 2nd sheet
plate_maps <- lapply(plate_map_files, function(f) {
  
  # Extract plate number
  Plate <- str_extract(basename(f), "\\d+")
  
  # Check number of sheets
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(f)
  
  # Use second sheet if it exists, otherwise first
  sheet_to_read <- if(length(sheets) >= 2) sheets[2] else sheets[1]
  
  readxl::read_excel(f, sheet = sheet_to_read) %>%
    mutate(
      Plate = Plate,
      across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(.x, "")),
      Concentration = as.numeric(Concentration)
    )})

plate_map <- bind_rows(plate_maps)

df_combined <- df %>%
  left_join(
    plate_map,
    by = c("Well", "Plate")
  )

# Remove all-NA columns this is like random colomns
df_combined <- df_combined %>%
  dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

# Remove rows without valid stain this is like random ropws from colombus analysis
df_combined <- df_combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(stain))

# Reshape for CellProfiler
df_cp <- df_combined %>%
  mutate(
    FileName = basename(filepath),
    PathName = dirname(filepath)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(
      Plate,
      Well,
      Site,
      Chemical,
      Concentration
    ),
    names_from = stain,
    values_from = c(FileName, PathName),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{stain}"
  ) %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ paste0("Metadata_", .),
    c(Plate, Well, Site, Chemical, Concentration)
  )

# Set DMSO controls
df_cp <- df_cp %>%
  mutate(
    Metadata_Chemical = ifelse(
      Metadata_Concentration == 0,
      "DMSO",
      Metadata_Chemical
    )
  )

# Clean column names
df_cp <- df_cp %>%
  rename_with(~ gsub(" ", "", .))

# Convert list columns to character
df_cp <- df_cp %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.list), ~ sapply(., `[`, 1)))

sapply(df_cp, class)

# Write 1 csv per plate

df_cp %>%
  group_split(Metadata_Plate) %>%
  walk(~{
    plate_id <- unique(.x$Metadata_Plate)
    
    write_csv(.x, paste0(metadata_path, "/metadata_plate_", plate_id, ".csv"))
  })

```

#Create combine tfs fro cell pose training in GUI
```{r}
#only keep channels i need for cell pose training
df <- df %>%
  filter(channel %in% c(1,2,4)) 

# define desired channel order
stain_order <- c("DNA",  "Mito", "ER")


for (p in unique(df$Plate)) {

  df_plate <- df %>% filter(Plate == p)

  plate_folder <- file.path(output_base, paste0("Plate_", p))
  dir.create(plate_folder, showWarnings = FALSE)

  wells <- unique(df_plate$Well)

  for (w in wells) {

    df_well <- df_plate %>% filter(Well == w)

    sites <- unique(df_well$Site)

    for (s in sites) {

      df_site <- df_well %>% filter(Site == s)

      imgs <- list()

      for (st in stain_order) {

        df_stain <- df_site %>% filter(stain == st)

        if (nrow(df_stain) == 0) next

        file <- df_stain$filepath[1]

        imgs[[st]] <- readTIFF(file)
      }

      # skip incomplete sets
      if (length(imgs) < 2) next

      stack <- abind::abind(imgs, along = 3)

      out_file <- file.path(
        plate_folder,
        paste0(w, "_Site", s, ".tif")
      )

     writeTIFF(stack, out_file) # multi-page TIFF (Cellpose-friendly)
    }
  }

  cat("Finished Plate:", p, "\n")
}
```
